manifest.title: Zero velocity isn’t zero acceleration.
manifest.summary: Compare a tossed ball with a ball dropped from rest at the apex to see why acceleration remains nonzero at the peak.
manifest.description: Two side-by-side lanes show a tossed ball and a dropped ball with velocity and acceleration vectors, illustrating that velocity is zero at the peak while acceleration remains constant.
assumptions: No air resistance, the same gravity for both balls, up is positive.
manifest.instructions: Change launch speed or gravity, then press Play. At each pause, compare velocity and acceleration.
